market_summary: All three assets are consolidating in tight ranges during the London session without breakout volume confirmation. GBPUSD and US100 are stuck inside their respective session Value Areas around flat VWAPs, while BTCUSD is weakly trading below its VAL but pausing above session lows. Maintaining patience with universal HOLDs across the board until London/NY overlap introduces definitive directional expansion.

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32599 to VAH 1.32797) and sitting slightly above POC 1.32738. CVD is BEARISH (-2670.22) with a negative slope (-611.31), diverging from the recent minor intraday bounce. During the current LONDON_SESSION, price is holding above VWAP 1.32668 and EMA50 1.32701, but is stalled mid-channel between the ATR bands without expansion. Volume shows no RVOL confirmation (rvol 0.91, grey bars). Structure is capped directly overhead by Session High at 1.32809 with support at S/R 1.32661. Lacking breakout volume and trapped inside Value Area warrants a HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral hovering near EMA50 and VWAP

signals.rationale: Price is positioned inside the session Value Area (VAL 28086.57 to VAH 28190.28) and above POC 28117.21. CVD is BEARISH (-3.34) with declining slope (-1.51). In the LONDON_SESSION, price sits just above VWAP (28132.22) but remains suppressed below EMA50 (28164.30). ATR bands are flat and price is hovering mid-channel without directional stretch. RVOL is muted at 0.665 (normal tick volume behavior, but lack of momentum confluence). Key nearby levels include Session High at 28265.71 and support S/R at 28100.36. No GEX active. With mixed trend signals and chop inside the Value Area, setup is a clear HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral consolidating above VWAP and below EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is trading below VAL (73377.88) and below POC (73522.35), confirming bearish session distribution. CVD is BEARISH (-0.04) with negative slope (-0.01), agreeing with the lower price trend. Context is LONDON_SESSION, with price well below descending VWAP 73598.98 and EMA50 73593.01. Candles are operating in the lower half of the ATR channel. Volume is sub-threshold (RVOL 0.804) but price is consistently compressing right above Session Low 73166.0 and testing local S/R 73284.6. Given low volume and no clean high-conviction breakdown trigger yet, stance remains HOLD to avoid selling directly into local double-bottom support.
